key_points: Morgan Stanley upgraded Wells Fargo to Overweight/Buy, citing easing funding pressures and margin improvement.
Insider buying: directors acquired deferred stock units and received stock awards.
Analysts highlight buyback upside potential and improved capital return outlook through 2028.
UBS lowered its price target, showing some caution ahead of Q3 earnings.
Q3'26 revenue estimate is $22.29B; earnings release scheduled for Tuesday.
